layers.description: The ownership layer from the Surface Management Agency (SMA) dataset depicts polygon boundaries of federal, state, local, and private land surface ownership and management jurisdiction across the contiguous United States. It is maintained by the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) and is used to identify which agency is responsible for managing a given parcel of land. The dataset is commonly used for land use planning, permitting, environmental review, and natural resource management. Each polygon is attributed with a code representing the administering agency, ranging from major federal land management agencies (e.g., BLM, USFS, NPS, FWS) to Department of Defense branches, state governments, tribal lands, and private holdings.

columns.name: sma_id
columns.description: The unique identifier key associated to the unique combination of master SMA information made up of administrative department, administrative agency, and land designation.

columns.name: admin_st
columns.description: BLM Administrative State or State Group e.g. ES = Eastern States

columns.name: admin_unit_name
columns.description: The name of the land designation. The name of the site or area (i.e. Saguaro National Park, Saddle Mountain Wilderness, or Yukon Delta National Wildlife Refuge, etc.)

columns.name: admin_unit_type
columns.description: The category of the function the land designation fulfills (i.e. National Historic Site, Wilderness, Wildlife Management Unit, etc.).

columns.name: admin_dept_code
columns.description: The acronym for the department responsible for managing the land designation.

columns.name: admin_agency_code
columns.description: Acronym for the agency responsible for managing the land designation. An abbreviated code identifying the agency or entity responsible for managing or administering the land surface within the polygon. Common values include: BLM (Bureau of Land Management), USFS (U.S. Forest Service), NPS (National Park Service), ST (State), LG (Local Government), PVT (Private), UND (Undetermined).

columns.name: h3geo
columns.description: The H3Geo grid at resolution 3 (average edge length 69 km) was intersected with the original layer to avoid extremely large, unmanageable polygons. This is the hex representation as string for the cell.

layers.description: Lookup Table for admin_dept_code and admin_agency_code values used in SMA (Ownership) layer. Compiled from at least two different BLM metadata files.
